card.name: Word completing a frequency or manner phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a short set phrase, most often 'daily' or 'weekly' after 'once' in a dosing schedule. It also fires on nouns ending fixed phrases such as 'at random', 'in color' and 'tone of voice'.

modes.label: Once daily/weekly
modes.description: 'daily' or 'weekly' right after 'once' in a dose schedule.

modes.label: Other fixed phrase endings
modes.description: A noun that closes an idiom such as 'at random', 'in color' or 'tone of voice'.
